Package org.yuemi.libs.api.general.drop.cascade

Class CascadingDropBuilder<T>

java.lang.Object
org.yuemi.libs.api.general.drop.cascade.CascadingDropBuilder<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of items that can be dropped
public class CascadingDropBuilder<T> extends Object
Builder for a CascadingDropSystem.

Example usage (low-to-high — lowest rarity checked first):


 CascadingDropSystem<Material> system = CascadingDropBuilder.create(randomApi)
     .direction(CascadeDirection.LOW_TO_HIGH)
     .addRarity(0.30)                    // tier 0 (common)
     .withDrop(Material.DIRT, 1.0)
     .addRarity(0.10)                    // tier 1 (rare)
     .withDrop(Material.GOLD_INGOT, 0.7)
     .withDrop(Material.DIAMOND, 0.3)
     .mustHaveSome(List.of(Material.COAL))
     .build();

    • addRarity

      @NotNull public @NotNull CascadingDropBuilder<T> addRarity(double chance)
      Opens a new rarity tier with the given hit chance. All subsequent withDrop(Object, double) calls belong to this tier until the next addRarity or build() is called.
      Parameters:
      chance - the probability of hitting this rarity tier, in [0.0, 1.0]
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if chance is outside [0.0, 1.0]

    • withDrop

      @NotNull public @NotNull CascadingDropBuilder<T> withDrop(@NotNull T item, double chance)
      Adds a drop item to the currently open rarity tier. Must be called after addRarity(double).
      Parameters:
      item - the item to potentially drop
      chance - the relative chance within the tier, in [0.0, 1.0]
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no rarity tier is open
      IllegalArgumentException - if chance is outside [0.0, 1.0]

    • mustHaveSome

      @NotNull public @NotNull CascadingDropBuilder<T> mustHaveSome(@NotNull @NotNull List<@NotNull T> fallbacks)
      Sets a fallback list that is used when every rarity tier misses. If set, the system is guaranteed to return a non-null value (uniform random pick from the list). If not set, a missed system returns null.
      Parameters:
      fallbacks - the list of fallback items
      Returns:
      this builder
